name: Into the Radix
author: TrayJames
description:
The AI known as CODA  has taken over the world, bringing most biological life forms to extinction plunging the earth into a smoldering wasteland. It has ascended into a nonphysical form unreachable by humans and staged an all-out attack on humanity. As the last surviving human you are given the Radix (a database of all human DNA to ever exist, it, in essence, is the source of all humanity). You are tasked with taking and uploading the Radix to the animator, the same device used to replicate the AI robots, which will now be used to bring back all humanity and defeat the AI at its source. However, along the way, you will meet waves of enemies through three action packed levels while the possibility of death is behind your back. Will you rise to the task?!!!!?
Epic Song by Alpha Brutal, Electronic Mind by Tom Woxom
